corpus_filing_warnings: TWO ASSOCIATIONS ARE NAMED IHSAA: Indiana's is ihsaa.org; Iowa's is iahsaa.org and Iowa's boys association is also 'IHSAA'. The corpus dir tools/scratch-11/ belongs to the [11] IOWA lane (11-iowa-ihsaa-ighsau.md): its ihsaa-members.csv (379 rows: ACGC, ADM, AGWSR; conferences River Valley / SEISC), p-ihsaa-*.html (435 iahsaa links, 0 'Indiana') and bound-ihsaa-* files are Iowa's. No Indiana fact in this lane is drawn from them; they are relabelled in samples/CAPTURES.md B5-IA.

tools/scratch-NN/ does not reliably mean report NN: tools/scratch-28/ serves the DAT/MileSplit super-index lanes (reports 18/28), gaps31-style dirs are cross-cutting. Per-file state identity was checked by reading the bytes.

A retained capture can disagree with its own ledger: gaps/38/il-schools.json measures 451188 B on disk while gaps/38/ledger.jsonl records 451182 B for the same URL. Both printed everywhere the file is cited; never averaged.
